items.title: Dennis Schroder came alive in the second half as Germany beat Poland in OT. Schroder had 18 points, 5 rebounds.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Dennis Schroder came alive in the second half as Germany beat Poland in OT. Schroder had 18 points, 5 rebounds.

Tristan da Silva had 9 points, 4 rebounds for Germany.

Mateusz Ponitka led Poland with 20/8/5. Jordan Loyd had 16 points for Poland.

items.title: Typical strong game from Dennis Schroder as Germany took down Netherlands: 23 points, 6 assists, 2 steals.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Typical strong game from Dennis Schroder as Germany took down Netherlands: 23 points, 6 assists, 2 steals.

Tristan da Silva: 5/6/4/2/1.

Rienk Mast, who played for Indiana at Summer League, had a strong game for Netherlands: 17 points, 5 rebounds.
